$comment: Node/Electron-main-process build for everything under src/ EXCEPT the tray renderer. DESIGN §2.1: the renderer (src/tray/renderer/**) runs inside Chromium and needs the DOM lib, which would leak into every Node-side file if it were included here — so it is excluded from this project and typechecked separately via tsconfig.tray.json (lib DOM+ES2023, noEmit; esbuild does its actual bundling/emit, see scripts/build-tray.mjs). Everything else, including src/tray/main.ts and src/tray/preload.ts (Electron main process, still plain Node), compiles here.
